label: AutoTrader UK Scraper
title: AutoTrader UK Scraper: Cars, Vans & Bikes to CSV
metaDescription: Scrape AutoTrader UK cars, vans, bikes and motorhomes from any search link: price, mileage, specs, registration, price rating, photos and seller details.
intro: Paste any AutoTrader UK search link (cars, vans, bikes, motorhomes, caravans, trucks, farm or plant) and get each listing's price, mileage, specs, registration, description, equipment, vehicle check, price rating, photos and seller details.
useCases: Price used cars by model, year and mileage
Monitor dealer inventory in a region

faq.q: Can I use my own AutoTrader search?
faq.a: Yes. Set your filters on autotrader.co.uk (make, model, price, year, mileage, fuel, gearbox, distance…), copy the address and paste it. The same filters apply to the data.

faq.q: Does it work for vans, motorbikes and motorhomes?
faq.a: Yes: cars, vans, motorbikes, motorhomes, caravans, trucks, farm, plant and electric bikes, plus single listing links.

faq.q: Can it get every listing when a search has thousands of results?
faq.a: Yes. Large searches are collected in full, not just the first pages, and a listing found by several of your links is delivered and charged once.

Registration, owners, service history, every seller phone number and website, description, equipment, the vehicle check, AutoTrader's price rating against the market, running costs and every photo in 1280×960.

faq.q: Do I need an AutoTrader account?
faq.a: No. It reads public search and listing pages; no login or cookies.

officialApi: AutoTrader UK's Connect APIs are for retailers and approved partners managing their own stock; they are not open to the public for searching other sellers' listings. This actor returns what any visitor sees on autotrader.co.uk, with AutoTrader's own field names.
